parameters.name: NewParamValue
parameters.how: Chooses what a newly drawn envelope point starts from: the target parameter's current value (the default) or its default value.
parameters.sound: It does not sound by itself; it decides where a new envelope line begins, so a fresh point either keeps what you hear or resets it.
